title: The Clean Two-Query Threshold for Unitary Synthesis
description:
This archive contains the preprint The Clean Two-Query Threshold for Unitary Synthesis, its self-contained sources, companion notes, verification code, and scoped Lean checks.

For fixed two-query architectures with arbitrary contractions and independent unimodular selectors, the Gaussian mean width is at most 2 min(N,Q) sqrt(log(2Q)). Universal clean synthesis consequently requires Omega(2^n) oracle input bits independently of workspace. A two-query permutation-transport construction matches the fixed-error exponential resource threshold.

This does not resolve unrestricted two-query synthesis with garbage or the full Aaronson-Kuperberg problem. The complete analytic proof is not formalized. The recorded AI audits are not external peer review.
